deficiencies.description: The text states that this occurs during adolescence and maturation, but the rewrite substitutes 'differentiation' for 'adolescence'.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: because obviously during adolescence and maturation, this occurs from infancy to adulthood.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: because differentiation and maturation also occur from infancy to adulthood.

considerations.sourcePassage: most of your lineage specification and your expansive growth has happened during embryogenesis, during the time that you were born.
considerations.reason: The phrase 'during the time that you were born' was dropped because it directly contradicts 'during embryogenesis' and is an obvious slip of the tongue by the lecturer.

considerations.sourcePassage: which would be here into the invading stroma.
considerations.reason: Changing 'invading stroma' to 'invaded stroma' corrects a slip by the speaker to state what is scientifically correct, as it is the tumour cells that invade and the stroma that is invaded.

considerations.sourcePassage: And you can see here now the cells are all of different shapes and sizes.
considerations.reason: The rewrite phrase 'In the image of the invasive tissue' accurately clarifies the lecturer's deictic reference ('here now') based on the context of the tissue shown.
